import ezdxf

HOLE_C, HOLE_D = (80.0, 50.0), 20.0

for name, color in [("OUTLINE", 7), ("HOLES", 1), ("CENTER", 3), ("DIM", 4)]:
    doc.layers.add(name, color=color)
if "CENTER" not in doc.linetypes:
    pass
doc.layers.get("CENTER").dxf.linetype = "CENTER"
msp = doc.modelspace()

# 外形：带 R8 圆角的矩形（逆时针，90° 圆弧 bulge = tan(90°/4)）
b = math.tan(math.radians(90) / 4)

    (R, 0, 0), (W - R, 0, b),
    (W, R, 0), (W, H - R, b),
    (W - R, H, 0), (R, H, b),
    (0, H - R, 0), (0, R, b),
]
msp.add_lwpolyline(outline, format="xyb", close=True, dxfattribs={"layer": "OUTLINE"})

# 长圆孔：直线段长 = 30 - 10 = 20，两端 R5 半圆
r = SLOT_W / 2
half = (SLOT_L - SLOT_W) / 2

    pts = [
        (cx - half, cy - r, 0), (cx + half, cy - r, 1),
        (cx + half, cy + r, 0), (cx - half, cy + r, 1),
    ]

    msp.add_line((cx - SLOT_L / 2 - 4, cy), (cx + SLOT_L / 2 + 4, cy), dxfattribs={"layer": "CENTER"})
    msp.add_line((cx, cy - r - 4), (cx, cy + r + 4), dxfattribs={"layer": "CENTER"})

# 中心圆孔
msp.add_circle(HOLE_C, HOLE_D / 2, dxfattribs={"layer": "HOLES"})
hx, hy = HOLE_C
msp.add_line((hx - 14, hy), (hx + 14, hy), dxfattribs={"layer": "CENTER"})
msp.add_line((hx, hy - 14), (hx, hy + 14), dxfattribs={"layer": "CENTER"})

# ---------- 标注 ----------

ov = {"dimtxt": 3.5, "dimasz": 3.0}

                   override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()
# 总宽 100

                   override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()

                   angle=0, override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()
# 长圆孔宽 10（左孔，标在左侧）
msp.add_linear_dim(base=(c1x - SLOT_L / 2 - 8, 0), p1=(c1x - half, c1y - r), p2=(c1x - half, c1y + r),
                   angle=90, override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()

                   angle=0, override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()
# 中心孔 Ø20
msp.add_diameter_dim(center=HOLE_C, radius=HOLE_D / 2, angle=45,
                     override=ov, dxfattribs=da).render()

doc.saveas("slot_plate.dxf")
print("saved slot_plate.dxf")

import ezdxf
from ezdxf import bbox

doc = ezdxf.readfile("slot_plate.dxf")
msp = doc.modelspace()
print("audit errors:", len(doc.audit().errors))

for e in msp:
    t = e.dxftype()
    if t == "LWPOLYLINE":
        pts = [tuple(round(v, 3) for v in p) for p in e.get_points("xyb")]
        ext = bbox.extents([e])
        print(t, e.dxf.layer, "closed" if e.closed else "open", pts,
              "bbox", tuple(round(v, 3) for v in ext.extmin)[:2], tuple(round(v, 3) for v in ext.extmax)[:2])
    elif t == "CIRCLE":
        print(t, e.dxf.layer, tuple(e.dxf.center)[:2], "D =", 2 * e.dxf.radius)
    elif t == "DIMENSION":
        print(t, "type", e.dimtype & 0x0F, "measurement =", round(e.get_measurement(), 3),
              "defpoints", tuple(round(v, 2) for v in e.dxf.defpoint)[:2],
              tuple(round(v, 2) for v in e.dxf.defpoint2)[:2], tuple(round(v, 2) for v in e.dxf.defpoint3)[:2])
        blk = doc.blocks.get(e.dxf.geometry)
        texts = [x.plain_text() for x in blk if x.dxftype() == "MTEXT"]
        print("   text:", texts)

all_ext = bbox.extents(msp)
print("overall extents:", all_ext.extmin, all_ext.extmax)
